# Legacy oracles

Everything here is cut or captured from the frozen pages under `legacy/` and pinned; the
migration's differential tests run the typed modules beside these (docs/MIGRATION.md steps 2, 10
and 11).

| Path                     | What                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | Regenerate                                                         |
| ------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `*.cjs`, `MANIFEST.json` | Script blocks cut verbatim out of the pages by `tools/legacy/extract-*.ts`; the manifest pins the page line ranges and the fixtures by sha256 (`manifest.test.ts`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | `npm run fixtures:legacy`                                          |
| `gin-wire/*.json`        | Every frame tag the legacy gin UI sends over its data channel, one file per tag (`state` split across files): the views, actions and refusals come from seeded games on the pinned legacy engine with `Date.now` pinned, so `gin-wire.test.ts` re-records and compares. A live two-peer capture is CI-only (step 12).                                                                                                                                                                              | `npm run fixtures:gin-wire`                                        |
| `gin-storage/*.json`     | The exact strings the legacy gin page wrote under each `ginRummy*` localStorage key (`raw`), one file per key and variant, captured from the page itself in headless Chromium (`captured` says what the page did first). `ginRummyMP_v1.host.midHand` reaches the host branch through the page's `window.__gin` hook (a connected guest is not available without a second peer); `ginRummyMP_v1.guest.derived` is derived from `persist()`, since the guest writes it only when its channel opens. | `npm run fixtures:gin-storage` (needs Chromium; timestamps change) |
